title: Should you watch the Python tutorial?

cues.en: The purpose of this video is for me to give you some recommendations on whether you should go through
cues.zh: 這支影片的目的，是建議你是否應該先看，

cues.en: the Python tutorial that I have at the end of this course.
cues.zh: 本課程最後的 Python 教學。

cues.en: So there is an appendix, several sections at the end of this course.
cues.zh: 課程最後有附錄，分成幾個章節。

cues.en: That's all on Python coding.
cues.zh: 全部是 Python 程式內容。

cues.en: It contains a little bit under 8 hours of video of intro to Python coding.
cues.zh: 包含將近八小時的 Python 程式入門影片。

cues.en: This is designed for beginners to Python.
cues.zh: 是為 Python 初學者設計。

cues.en: I have a lot of explanations, lots of examples and many, many exercises.
cues.zh: 有許多解釋、範例和非常多練習。

cues.en: Now it's around 8 hours of video.
cues.zh: 影片大約八小時。

cues.en: If you go through all of the exercises as well, then it's probably somewhere around 12 to 15 hours of total time for you.
cues.zh: 如果也完成全部練習，總共可能需要十二到十五小時。

cues.en: If you go through every video and every single exercise.
cues.zh: 也就是看每支影片、做每個練習。

cues.en: So just something to be mindful of.
cues.zh: 所以請留意時間。

cues.en: If you are enrolled in a different course of mind that's called Master Python for scientific coding, then you do not need to go through the appendix of this course.
cues.zh: 如果已報名我另一門 Master Python for Scientific Coding，就不必看這門課的附錄。

cues.en: It's very similar to part one of that course.
cues.zh: 和那門課第一部分很相似。

cues.en: It's not exactly the same.
cues.zh: 不完全一樣。

cues.en: I have modified the videos and selected the videos, so it's the appendix in this course is really just about the python coding skills that you will need for this course.
cues.zh: 我有修改並挑選影片，所以這門課的附錄，真正著重的是本課所需的 Python 程式能力。

cues.en: So to be clear, this other course of mine is totally separate.
cues.zh: 說清楚，另一門課完全獨立。

cues.en: It's not a prerequisite.
cues.zh: 不是先修條件。

cues.en: You do not need to go through this course Master Python for scientific coding in order to successfully complete this course on calculus.
cues.zh: 不需要先上 Master Python for Scientific Coding，才能順利完成這門微積分課。

cues.en: As I mentioned, this appendix is designed for beginners, so if you are new to coding or if you are
cues.zh: 如前所說，附錄為初學者設計，所以如果剛接觸程式，或，

cues.en: familiar with other coding languages like MATLAB or C or Java, but you're new to Python, then I definitely encourage you to go through the appendix.
cues.zh: 熟悉 MATLAB、C、Java 等其他語言，但 Python 是新手，我很鼓勵先看附錄。

cues.en: If you are kind of familiar with Python, maybe you already have some experience.
cues.zh: 如果有點熟悉 Python，也許已有經驗。

cues.en: You've worked with Python before, but you don't feel totally comfortable with your python expertise.
cues.zh: 以前用過，但對自己的 Python 能力還不太有信心。

cues.en: Then I recommend still going through the appendix, but maybe you can pick and choose which videos you want to focus on versus Skip.
cues.zh: 我仍建議看附錄，但可以挑選想著重和想跳過的影片。

cues.en: Maybe you want to watch all the videos, but put them at two x speed so you're getting through them faster.
cues.zh: 也許想全部看完，但用兩倍速，加快進度。

cues.en: I will leave this up to you if you consider yourself to be quite comfortable with Python in particular with the numpy, the sim pie and the map plot lib libraries.
cues.zh: 由你決定。如果自認很熟悉 Python，尤其 NumPy、SymPy 和 matplotlib，

cues.en: Those are the three most important libraries in this course.
cues.zh: 這三個是本課最重要的函式庫。

cues.en: NumPy sim pie and map plot lib.
cues.zh: NumPy、SymPy 和 matplotlib。

cues.en: Then you can skip the appendix entirely or, you know, maybe have a quick look through the titles of the videos and maybe there's one or two videos you want to brush up on.
cues.zh: 那就能完全跳過附錄，或快速看看影片標題，也許有一、兩支想複習。

cues.en: So I hope that helps you decide whether you should go through the Python tutorial at the end of this course before beginning with the calculus parts of the course in the next section.
cues.zh: 希望這能幫你決定，在下一節開始微積分內容前，是否先看課程最後的 Python 教學。
